description: This file defines a Flutter widget `PlayerScreen` that simulates a media player interface with controls for playback, seeking, and persisting progress. It includes state management, timers, and interactions with dependencies such as content repository and home controller.

classes.name: PlayerScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing a media player interface with controls for playback, seeking, and progress persistence.

classes.name: _PlayerScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the PlayerScreen widget's internal state, timers, and user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the player state, sets the starting position, and starts the ticker timer.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer and cleans up resources when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _startTicker
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer that updates the playback position every second if playing.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles the playback state between play and pause.

methods.name: seekBy
methods.description: Adjusts the playback position by a specified number of seconds within bounds.

methods.name: persistProgress
methods.description: Async method to save current playback progress and notify the home controller, with user feedback via snackbar.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Async method to mark playback as completed, reset position, notify home controller, and inform user.

methods.name: _format
methods.description: Formats seconds into a mm ss string.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the player UI, including video placeholder, progress, controls, and info.
